title: RELIC PREVIEW SHOP
description: Draft rooms now preview one upcoming relic synergy before the player commits, with optional paid rerolls for the shop inventory between encounters.
consequence: Players start making builds on purpose. The store starts calling indecision a feature.

title: DRAFT REFUND RULE
description: Card shops now let players undo one purchase per floor after testing the card in combat, refunding the full cost if the run survives.
consequence: Players stop treating every shop like a tax audit. The receipt learns humility.

title: INSURANCE EXTRACTION TOKEN
description: Extraction runs now offer a paid insurance token that protects one backpack slot if the player dies before reaching the elevator.
consequence: The dungeon keeps its teeth. The checkout page gets a helmet.

title: STARTER DECK INSPECTION
description: New runs now begin with a mandatory deck inspection screen that flags weak cards, recommends removals, and blocks the first encounter until every warning is dismissed.
consequence: The run gets a lecture before it gets a turn. The shop window fogs up behind the checklist.
